//: Adapter registry. Pipeline code references an adapter by id only. An entry is usable when status=adopted and its eval report exists. Adapter files live under output/train/ (gitignored); provenance is the base model + config + dataset manifest hashes, so a run is reproducible without committing weights.

adapters.notes: Pilot adapter. Passes the corrected gate, but the corpus contained 28 pattern (trim-sheet) tiles, so it draws chevrons/grids onto surfaces. Superseded by materials_v2. Kept for A/B comparison.
First clean corpus (patterns/decals excluded, 168 tiles). 800 steps, 384 px, LR 5e-5. Gate: tiling 0.958 (mean ratio 0.996), material 1.0, style 1.0, regression 1.0.
